modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
One of these product shots cost 2x more to make.
Same prompt, two AI video models, zero edits.

I work in sales at a school that teaches Meta ads.
Our team builds one creative concept per customer portrait.
That is more product footage than a small brand can film.

So I typed one prompt:
a serum bottle, a wave of water, slow motion.

Top: Kling 4.0
Bottom: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite

No studio. No crew. No product sample.

One clip opens calm and lets the wave arrive.
The other opens on the splash.
For a feed ad I'd take the second: the first second already moves.

Which one was cheaper is in the reply.
